extraction.policy_summary: Brigade states it is an equal opportunity employer, 'fully compliant with the PWD Act, 2016', and does not discriminate on the basis of disability in employment; selection is based solely on performance and merit. This is codified in a Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) Policy available at a public web link.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: FY2025-26: 18 differently abled employees (13 male, 72.22%; 5 female, 27.78%) and 6 differently abled workers (5 male, 83.33%; 1 female, 16.67%), out of a total employee and worker base of 3,392 reported in the headline diversity table.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: All buildings are designed per the National Building Code (NBC) of India to address accessibility needs, including wheelchair ramps at entry and exit points, designated/reserved parking spaces for differently abled people, non-slip pathways with tactile indicators, elevators with braille-enabled controls and/or voice guidance, and wheelchair-accessible restrooms with support features. Stated as applying to both employee workplaces and visitor-facing premises.
